lessons.claim: [W]'s appendix K Lennard-Jones sigma/epsilon are for gas transport coefficients (Chapman-Enskog mu = 2.6693e-6 sqrt(MT)/(sigma^2 Omega_mu)) and share only the symbols with our pair.LJ sigma/epsilon; the physics is different -- taking the values from there into a colloidal pair potential must not be done. And liquid viscosity has no molecular theory (only the Eyring approximation) so it has to be read from a table and must not be computed from a formula
